item.title: Russia’s Pantsir Air and Missile Defense System Just Quadrupled Its Firepower
item.summary: Pantsir-SMD – the new version of Russia’s Pantsir SAM & AA system, has undergone modernization work that “touched on virtually all” of its elements, “including radar station, missile guidance and most crucially, the missiles themselves,” military expert and air defense historian Yuri Knutov told Sputnik.
